rules.title: Loan existence and status check
rules.statement: Raises LMS-001 if loan not found; raises LMS-021 if status is not ACTIVE.

rules.title: Quote date validation
rules.statement: Raises LMS-002 if p_quote_date is before disbursement date.

rules.title: Principal amount selection
rules.notes: Handles missing outstanding value with coalesce.

rules.title: Interest rate selection
rules.statement: Uses fixed_rate_pct when rate_type=FIXED; otherwise uses latest benchmark_rate effective on or before quote date plus spread_pct, defaulting to 0.
rules.notes: No calendar or holiday adjustment applied.

rules.title: Accrual days and day-count fraction
rules.statement: Computes v_days as greatest(quote_date minus coalesce(last_run_date, disb_date), 0); divides by 365 when day_count=ACT365 else 360.
rules.notes: Day count taken from product; no ACT/365L or other variants.

rules.title: Interest amount with rounding
rules.statement: Adds already-accrued_interest to round(principal * rate/100 * days / divisor, 2).
rules.notes: Single rounding to two decimal places at the end of the calculation.

rules.title: Penal interest and fees passthrough
rules.statement: Copies accrued_penal directly to o_penal and fees_outstanding directly to o_fees.

rules.title: Prepayment fee eligibility and rounding
rules.statement: Calculates months remaining as tenor_months minus full months since disbursement; if rate_type=FIXED, prepay_fee_pct not null and remaining > 3 then round(principal * prepay_fee_pct / 100, 2) else 0.
rules.notes: Uses age() for month difference; rounding to two decimals.

rules.title: GST on fees
rules.notes: Fixed 18% rate; rounding to two decimals.

rules.title: Total payoff amount
rules.statement: Sets o_total to greatest(principal + interest + penal + fees + prepay_fee + gst - advance_balance, 0).
rules.notes: Uses greatest to enforce non-negative result.

rules.title: Quote validity period
rules.statement: Sets o_valid_until to p_quote_date + 2 (two calendar days).

open_questions: Confirm that advance_balance is always subtracted and that negative totals are forced to zero.
Confirm that GST applies only to prepay_fee plus fees_outstanding and never to interest or penal.
Confirm that the month-difference calculation for remaining tenor ignores partial months and day-of-month.
